title: Jacobi algorithm on encoded integers
statement: For natural numbers $a$ and $n$ with $n$ odd, applying the Jacobi algorithm to the pair encoding of their binary expansions yields the binary expansion of $(\operatorname{jacobiSym}(a,n)+1).toNat$.
caveat: The expression $(\operatorname{jacobiSym}(a,n)+1).toNat$ is Lean-specific and the provided definitions do not explain the conversion or the Jacobi symbol’s range; its exact mathematical rendering is unclear.
